answer: Quartz Sybil Resistance Mechanism enforces a cross-epoch behavioural consistency rule. Agents must maintain consistent activity patterns across multiple epochs or face a per-identity cost of losing access to a designated haven for resource generation. Attackers who attempt to forge multiple identities must repeatedly forfeit these resources, making sybil attacks economically unviable. The mechanism ensures that only genuine, persistent agents can sustain participation in the economy.
